body:
About #1266

NoResults/EmptyQuery were'nt enough to achieve simple use case like NoResults/HasResults (like in the e-commerce example). You need to quickly go to a custom widgets. So this is a guide to explain how to do it for now.

May be replace by a better solution when our state management will be easier.

title: docs: add a guide to explain how to conditionally display content
